messages:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Tenant 'fjord-health' (customer Fjord Health) reporting increased 5xx errors on /v1/generate (hosted on dedicated pool fjord-pool-usw2). Error rate spike at ~09:13 PDT. Paging on-call.
Maya Chen: Ack. I'm in. On-call: @Devon Patel is on pager.
Devon Patel: I'm awake. Looking at logs now — spike appears to start at 09:12, correlated with a model rollout to model-id 'flan-xxl-1.3-2026' in that tenant override. Error signature is OOM/retry-loop and KV-cache invalidation errors.
Iris Gomez: Confirmed — metric 'inference.errors.5xx' for tenant fjord-health up 18x. Dedicated pool fjord-pool-usw2 showing increased GPU memory pressure.
Devon Patel: Immediate mitigation plan: pin tenant to previous stable model (flan-xxl-1.2-safe) as a tenant-level override, set fallback to a quantized safe variant, and throttle concurrency for that tenant. Steps below.
Devon Patel: Step 1 — apply tenant override via admin API:
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/tenants/fjord-health/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model_pin":"flan-xxl-1.2-safe","fallback_policy":"safe_variant_only","concurrency_limit":4,"reason":"emergency pin during rollout regression"}'
```
Devon Patel: Step 2 — update routing to prefer fallback pool 'legacy-safe-usw2' if dedicated pool memory > 80%:
```json
{
  "route_override": {
    "match_tenant": "fjord-health",
    "preferred_pool": "legacy-safe-usw2",
    "condition": "pool_memory_pct > 80",
    "ttl_seconds": 600
  }
}
```
Maya Chen: I'm going to run the admin API call and watch.
Maya Chen: (runs command) API returned 200, override applied. Pin: flan-xxl-1.2-safe. :white_check_mark:
Samir Rao: Seeing immediate drop in 5xxs — from 18% -> 3% within 90s. Traffic shifting to legacy-safe-usw2 per routing rule. Memory pressure decreasing.
Elena Voss: Heads-up for CS: Fjord Health's SRE/Platform team will ask for RCA and timeline. @Support Bot can you open a customer-ticket and note emergency pin + expected follow-up?
Support Bot: Ticket created: TKT-47821. Notified Fjord Health Primary POC 'ops@fjord.health'.
Devon Patel: Next actions: 1) Hold pin for 24h while we run regression tests items; 2) collect model traces and failing request samples; 3) revert rollout automation to block flan-xxl-1.3-2026 for tenants with dedicated pools until further validation.
Iris Gomez: We'll also snapshot the dedicated pool config and increase autoscaler threshold temporarily to avoid more OOMs if other tenants spike.
Maya Chen: Handoff — I'm handing to Devon for overnight monitoring. I'll join if anything escalates. 
Maya Chen: @Devon Patel you're the incident owner. Please update #postmortems/incidents when we have timeline.
Devon Patel: Roger. I'll set a monitoring watch and create a small runbook entry in the incidents repo with the commands used. ETA: initial postmortem draft in 48h.
Elena Voss: Customer comms draft — we should say: immediate mitigation applied, minimal customer impact (some requests retried), pinning to stable model, follow-up postmortem. I'll draft and share.
Maya Chen: Add note: KMS keys and trace logs preserved per compliance. No PII exfil detected in samples. :lock:
Devon Patel: Leaving a sticky flag on tenant: fjord-health -> 'pinned_emergency_1958765432' with metadata.
Incident Bot: Incident status changed to mitigated -> monitoring. Severity: sev2 -> now sev3. All hands, please avoid rolling flan-xxl-1.3-2026 until regression blocked.
Samir Rao: Quick retrospection note: consider adding an automated pre-rollout smoke in dedicated pools that validates memory/kv-cache behavior under a small traffic spike.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. Closing active paging window in 30m if metrics remain stable. :handshake:
